name: SLÄKT storage bed, desk in the window corner with BESTÅ storage above (fewest pieces)
notes:
Alternative, re-checked 2026-10-23: the SLÄKT storage bed, fewest pieces, with the BESTÅ unit on the empty wall above the desk (F-63). Re-planned the same day for F-31's 36" landings: the book display stood on the closet doors' arc and the two DRÖNA boxes 0.5" past the door's arc. The bed's drawers need its open side and the desk the rest of the top wall, so they come off the plan; her books go on the SLÄKT's shelf, and the reading spot is the bed and the floor cushions on the rug. 12 placed, 9 extras.
bed-1 SLÄKT storage bed, head on the top wall, long side on the left wall, flush: its 2 drawers (33 lb each) and shelf open on the room side and replace the dresser, the TROFAST and the book display. F-32/F-34 27.25" clear at the head end to the desk, 41" to the chair and more below; F-33 bedding 71.5" from the heater face.
shelf-1 LACK wall shelf on the top wall beside the bed's head, about 10" above the mattress: the bedside table without legs, so the drawers open freely; 6.5 lb max, anchored (IKEA).
desk-1 FLISAT on the top wall in the window corner: F-33 right end 6" from the heater face; F-35 30" chair zone clear behind it, the chair 19.5" from the heater, not backed against a heater wall. chair-1 SUNDVIK at the desk ("Last chance").
cabinet-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, 47 1/4x16 1/2x15" (top, new): top wall above the desk, x 58.75-106, its right end 6" short of the heater face (F-33): closed storage hung above her reach for markers, paint, glue and rotation toys a parent hands down (F-63): solid LAPPVIKEN doors (no glass, F-21), hung on 2 BESTÅ suspension rails screwed into studs (extras), underside about 54" up. The canvas art moves to the left wall.
rug-1 VALLABY rot 90, x 46-98, y 43-82: the reading and play floor, 14" from the heater face (F-33); its left 18.5" lies inside the drawers' reach (22 1/2" deep inside, so they open to x 63, 4.75" short of the desk), flat, and the drawers' clearance over a rug is not on IKEA's page: check in the store whether they ride on the floor, and if they do, take this layout without the rug (final audit 2026-10-26).
canopy-1 LÖVA over the bed's head, mounted out of reach (IKEA). lamp-1 UPPLYST on the left wall over the bed, cord fastened. lamp-2 RÖDFLIK desk lamp (top) at the desk's left end, x 68.5-74.5, is her task light, the window on her right (none before the final audit 2026-10-26); its cord fastened along the top wall to an outlet. nightlight-1 TÖVÄDER on the LACK shelf; plant-1 FEJKA (artificial) on the desk; art-1 BLODFLÄDER (canvas, no glass, F-21) on the left wall at the bed's foot, y 70-86.5, its bottom above the footboard: it clears an open door up to 35.5" wide (at y 74-90.5 it cleared only a 30" door, by 1.5"; the door is unmeasured; final audit 2026-10-26).
Maddie is 4 (F-21): every piece within her reach is under 27" or anchored; no glass anywhere; no loft or bunk. The desk ends 12" from the window wall beside the window and her chair is a step onto it: fit window stops or guards on her window before she moves in (assumed-position:window, F-38; the sill is unmeasured). Standing on the desk she can open the BESTÅ cabinet hung above it, so give it a child lock or keep only washable, non-toxic supplies in it. The heater's type is unknown: if its cover gets hot, guard the 6" slot at the desk's end, where crayons fall.
Walkways (F-30): the 36" landings in front of the door and the closet are open floor (F-31); door to room straight up past the bed's foot, 44.9" below it; bed to desk 41".
Extras: ÅSVANG in the frame (SLÄKT's mattress is 38 1/4 x 74 3/8") with the DVALA fitted sheet (up to 10"), SMÅSPORRE insert, BARNDRÖM cover, low pillow, SKOGSDUVA cushions x2 as floor seats on the rug, BENGTA panel (cut to clear the heater, F-33) on the HUGAD rod (assumed-position:window), BESTÅ suspension rails x2. Not placed: the FLISAT book display ikea-80614566 and the two DRÖNA boxes ikea-30574006 (above).
Total $1,188.32: placed $890.89 + extras $297.43; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the art hangs 4" higher, above the footboard, to clear a door up to 35.5"; the safety lines of a and e are here too (window stops, a lock on the BESTÅ, the heater slot); a RÖDFLIK at the desk's left end is her task light; the SLÄKT's drawers open onto the rug, so check in the store whether they ride on the floor. The best circulation of the five: the bed's whole side opens onto at least 27" of floor.
